B1 Table with Chip and Button cells in a 300 px box
do: eval:[...document.querySelectorAll("[data-testid=fold-table] td button, [data-testid=fold-table] td .glass-chip")].map(e=>{const r=document.createRange();r.selectNodeContents(e);const t=new Set();for(const q of r.getClientRects())if(q.width>0.5&&q.height>4)t.add(Math.round(q.top));const b=e.getBoundingClientRect();return e.textContent.trim().slice(0,14)+' w'+Math.round(b.width*10)/10+' L'+t.size})
